status: sensitivity analysis, official target not confirmed
truth: all distinct items with one logged viewing overlap strictly >80% full airing duration, validation split1
single_session_proxy: maximum raw overlap fragment per user/airing/split; does not sum interrupted fragments
selection: exploratory, changed label definition motivated by external source; not directly comparable to original metric
boundary_policy: Raw sessions clipped at original train/validation cutoff; only within-window single-fragment overlap counts against full airing duration.
fallback_comparison: New frequency/popularity sensitivity variants use unique-viewer fallback at their own training fraction; not the fixed fallback used in original model comparison.
